# SplitButton

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:split-button` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

A primary action with an attached options trigger on one loud semantic fill.

## When to use

Render a prominent primary action plus an options trigger (provider, model, target) as one control with a semantic tone, full-width sizing, a busy presentation, and native aria-expanded on the trigger, outside any Toolbar.

- A prominent primary action has a closely related set of options chosen from an attached trigger, such as Drive with a provider menu or Deploy with targets.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for a plain action without options; use wa-button.
- Do not use inside a Toolbar for a command menu; use PopupMenu in a ToolbarControlGroup.
- Do not use wa-button-group to build one; its hosts do not forward aria-expanded or names to their inner buttons.

**Alternatives:**

- [Button Group](./wa-button-group.md) (prefer-over) — SplitButton's native halves expose names and aria-expanded directly.
- [PopupMenu](./popup-menu.md) (composes-with) — Open the app's options menu from optionsAction; PopupMenu remains the command menu inside a toolbar.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/split-button` — exports `SplitButton`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/split-button` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/split-button.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/split-button`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuisplit-button) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- brand, neutral, success, warning, or danger tone
- content width or fill
- busy
- disabled primary or options

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [LucideIcon](./lucide-icon.md), [LoadingSpinner](./loading-spinner.md).

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** the primary and options actions; the options menu and its open state; the running state, tone switch, and copy.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Both halves are native buttons in a group; the options trigger exposes aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, and optional aria-controls, and needs optionsLabel. busy sets aria-busy on the primary.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-split-button`, `kui-split-button__options`, `kui-split-button__icon`, `kui-split-button__label`.

Never put `kui-split-button`, `kui-split-button__options`, `kui-split-button__icon`, `kui-split-button__label` on an element you write; render `SplitButton` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-color-brand-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-brand-on-loud`, `--kui-color-neutral-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-neutral-on-loud`, `--kui-color-success-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-success-on-loud`, `--kui-color-warning-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-warning-on-loud`, `--kui-color-danger-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-danger-on-loud`, `--kui-focus-ring`, `--kui-font-weight-semibold`, `--kui-layout-rounded-radius`, `--kui-space-s`, `--kui-space-xs`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
